items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The LORD communicated with Moses through speech

items.quote: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
items.claim: Israelites are commanded regarding unintentional violations of the LORD's commandments
items.actor: the children of Israel, a soul
items.object: commandments of the LORD, things which ought not to be done

items.quote: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
items.claim: An anointed priest who sins must bring an unblemished bullock to the LORD as a sin offering
